name: The best parts for AI intelligence, assembled and proven
vision_statement: Anyone building AI intelligence can assemble a working system from the best open-source parts available, chosen by measurement and kept current every week, without writing the glue themselves.
opportunities: Any product that needs an AI grounded in a person or team's own goals can start from the assembled whole instead of researching and gluing parts again; a production consumer is the hardest test of the assembly.
solution_coherence: hub-of-hubs gives anyone a working AI assembled from measured open-source parts, and The whole being is the one call that holds the mind together. It answers a question through World in and Subconscious, Intuition, holds that answer to its sources through Critical thinking, asks a model at a measured tier through the Mind, shows a task the pieces of a folder's files it needs, within a token budget or not at all, through the context retriever, carries a goal out through the Body only after the Overseer lets the step pass, and checks that the hub stays generic through Character. World in brings outside material in by running a web search through web search and, for research questions, a paper lookup through Science. Subconscious, Intuition keeps cards in the card store, draws the cards a query needs by relevance through the context assembler, and fills the store from a folder's files through cards from files. Cards from files groups a folder's files into topic cards by which files import each other, so it writes them without asking a model. The Mind sends a question to the model that the model tier chooser measured best for the tier, through the model call, which is built on the vendor model caller. The Body makes each file edit with a single request through the vendor model caller, at the tier that the model tier chooser picks. Character audits the hub for consumer wording and learns how stale its research is through Learning. Character also learns how much of the hub connects by configuration through Hands. Learning lists the areas whose research is older than ninety days by reading their dates through the research freshness reader. Hands reports the share of connections that need no code by scoring them through the connection scorer.
